title: DK Bond Tracker Full Frontend UX Redesign (Two Stitch Tracks) — V-model spec suite
derived_from: Locked brainstorm D1-D10 (Discussion #335, 2026-11-23) + developer brief Q1-Q3 + remote sweep G1-G7

requirements.text: The redesign SHALL change frontend presentation only: no business logic, routing, DB, or API code may be altered, and the existing pytest suite SHALL stay green after implementation.

acceptance_criteria.given: the repository after any design-driven code change
acceptance_criteria.when: the existing pytest suite is run
acceptance_criteria.then: all tests pass with no test modified to accommodate the change

acceptance_criteria.given: the diff of a track's implementation
acceptance_criteria.then: only src/templates/**, src/static/** and android UI-layer files are touched

requirements.text: Every existing web route and Android screen SHALL have a redesigned counterpart — the screen inventory SHALL be complete with no screen dropped.

acceptance_criteria.then: each inventory entry maps to exactly one redesigned screen or documented exclusion

requirements.text: Both tracks SHALL receive byte-identical requirements briefs.

acceptance_criteria.when: the brief file in each is compared
acceptance_criteria.then: checksums are identical

requirements.text: Each track SHALL work in its own git worktree (design-track-a, design-track-b) cut from dev, with no cross-writes between tracks.

acceptance_criteria.then: both worktrees exist, folder name equals branch name, and each track's commits stay in its own worktree

requirements.text: Each track SHALL deliver a Stitch Canvas project (primary design tool) PLUS committed repo evidence: screenshots, manifest and DESIGN.md.

acceptance_criteria.when: its worktree and Stitch status are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: the Stitch project shows the redesigned screens and the worktree contains screenshots/, manifest and DESIGN.md

requirements.text: Each track SHALL cite at least 3 leading-app benchmark references and at least 3 modern UI/UX best-practice sources in its deliverable.

acceptance_criteria.then: >=3 benchmarks and >=3 best-practice sources are present and resolvable

requirements.text: The redesigned UI SHALL be free of duplicate components, overflow and layout breakage, and SHALL use one consistent design-token system (color, type, spacing, radius) across all screens and both platforms.

acceptance_criteria.when: an audit inspects for duplicated patterns, overflow and token drift
acceptance_criteria.then: no duplicate component definitions, no clipped/overlapping content, and all values resolve to shared tokens

requirements.text: Layouts SHALL be fluid and responsive: no horizontal scrolling or content clipping at 360px, 768px, 1280px and 1920px viewports on web, and correct fit on Android phone sizes.

acceptance_criteria.then: no horizontal scrollbar, no overlap, no clipped controls
content fits with readable hierarchy and reachable controls

requirements.text: The design SHALL meet accessibility basics: touch/click targets >=48px with >=8px gaps on touch surfaces, readable text contrast, and visible focus/pressed states.

acceptance_criteria.given: any interactive control in the design
acceptance_criteria.then: target size >=48px, gap to neighbours >=8px, and a visible focus/active state is specified

requirements.text: Navigation SHALL be coherent and consistent: one navigation model across web pages and a matching model on Android, with predictable placement of primary actions.

acceptance_criteria.then: primary nav placement and interaction patterns are consistent and documented in DESIGN.md

requirements.text: Auditor A1 SHALL produce audit reports for both tracks covering design quality, consistency, UX issues, accessibility, responsiveness and compliance with this suite.

acceptance_criteria.then: a report exists per track with findings, severities and evidence references

requirements.text: Reviewer R1 SHALL deliver an independent comparison review of both final designs with strengths, weaknesses, recommendations and evidence, supporting winner selection.

acceptance_criteria.then: a comparison report exists citing both designs with per-criterion findings and a recommendation

requirements.text: The developer SHALL select the winning design; the losing track SHALL be archived and never merged.

acceptance_criteria.given: both final deliveries plus R1's comparison
acceptance_criteria.then: the selection is recorded in the initiative report and only the winning track proceeds to implementation

requirements.text: All stage documents SHALL be projected into the SQLite store, gates SHALL pass green, and Discussion #335 SHALL remain the decision authority for the initiative.

acceptance_criteria.then: verify and --all --strict pass and stage status rows advance

prd_items.statement: Redesign the frontend UX top-to-bottom for web and Android with zero functionality change.

acceptance_criteria.given: the repository after the redesign implementation
acceptance_criteria.when: the existing pytest suite is run
acceptance_criteria.then: all tests pass and no logic file appears in the diff

prd_items.statement: Run two competing design tracks with byte-identical briefs; developer picks the winner.

acceptance_criteria.then: checksums are byte-identical

prd_items.statement: Track A = kimi + GLM-5.3-Flash (zai-coding-plan); Track B = agy + gemini-3.8-flash-high.

acceptance_criteria.when: fleet-guard --check-argv runs for both track argvs
acceptance_criteria.then: both exit 0 before spawn

prd_items.statement: Isolate tracks in worktrees design-track-a and design-track-b cut from dev.

acceptance_criteria.then: design-track-a and design-track-b exist with folder==branch, cut from dev

prd_items.statement: Stitch CLI is the primary design tool; each track exports evidence into its worktree.

acceptance_criteria.when: its Stitch status and worktree are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: the Stitch project holds the redesigned screens and screenshots/manifest/DESIGN.md are committed

prd_items.statement: Track the initiative under one umbrella issue using the existing initiative:dk-bond-tracker-ui-redesign label.

acceptance_criteria.then: only taxonomy labels from .fleet/config.json appear and it links Discussion #335

prd_items.statement: Auditor A1 audits both tracks throughout; Reviewer R1 compares the final designs.

acceptance_criteria.when: audit and review outputs are collected
acceptance_criteria.then: A1 reports exist per track and R1 delivers the final comparison with evidence

prd_items.statement: Redesign every existing screen on both platforms — no screen dropped.

acceptance_criteria.then: every existing web route and Android screen has a redesigned counterpart or documented exclusion

prd_items.statement: Each track researches modern UI/UX best practices and benchmarks leading apps, with citations.

acceptance_criteria.given: a track writes its research notes
acceptance_criteria.then: >=3 benchmark and >=3 best-practice sources are present and resolvable

prd_items.statement: Execute the full 5-stage PM pipeline; developer selects the winner at delivery.

acceptance_criteria.then: each stage gate has evidence and the developer's winner selection is recorded at delivery

test_cases.title: Existing pytest suite stays green after implementation (RD-01)
test_cases.steps: 1. Check out the winning track's implementation. 2. Run the full pytest suite unchanged.
test_cases.expected: All tests pass; no test file modified.

test_cases.title: Screen inventory completeness (RD-02)
test_cases.steps: 1. Extract route list from Flask app + Android screen list. 2. Map each to the deliverable checklist. 3. Flag unmapped entries.
test_cases.expected: Every inventory entry maps to a redesigned screen or a documented exclusion.

test_cases.title: Identical briefs across tracks (RD-03)
test_cases.steps: 1. sha256 the brief file in design-track-a. 2. sha256 the brief file in design-track-b. 3. Compare.

test_cases.title: Worktree isolation (RD-04)
test_cases.steps: 1. git worktree list. 2. Verify folder==branch for both. 3. Verify each track's commits are in its own worktree.
test_cases.expected: Both worktrees present, named correctly, no cross-writes.

test_cases.title: Stitch project + repo evidence present (RD-05)
test_cases.steps: 1. stitch status per track. 2. Check worktree for screenshots/, manifest, DESIGN.md.
test_cases.expected: Stitch flow complete and all evidence files committed.

test_cases.title: Research citations count (RD-06)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open each track's research notes. 2. Count benchmark refs and best-practice sources.
test_cases.expected: >=3 benchmarks and >=3 best-practice sources per track.

test_cases.title: Design quality audit: duplicates, overflow, token consistency (RD-07)
test_cases.steps: 1. A1 inspects all delivered screens. 2. Flags duplicate patterns, clipped content, off-token values.
test_cases.expected: Zero duplicates, zero overflow, all values on shared tokens (or findings logged with severity).

test_cases.title: Multi-width responsiveness check (RD-08)
test_cases.steps: 1. Render web designs at 360/768/1280/1920. 2. Inspect Android screens at phone viewport.
test_cases.expected: No horizontal scroll, overlap or clipping anywhere.

test_cases.title: Accessibility: touch targets, gaps, focus states (RD-09)
test_cases.steps: 1. Measure interactive targets in designs. 2. Check contrast and focus/pressed state specs.

test_cases.title: Navigation consistency walkthrough (RD-10)
test_cases.steps: 1. Walk every screen comparing nav placement and primary-action patterns. 2. Diff against DESIGN.md claims.
test_cases.expected: Consistent navigation model documented and followed.

test_cases.title: Audit reports delivered per track (RD-11)
test_cases.steps: 1. Collect A1 outputs at each milestone. 2. Verify findings + severities + evidence present.
test_cases.expected: Audit report exists per track covering all six audit dimensions.

test_cases.title: Independent comparison review delivered (RD-12)
test_cases.steps: 1. Collect R1 comparison report. 2. Verify strengths/weaknesses/recommendation + evidence citations.
test_cases.expected: Comparison report exists with per-criterion findings and a recommendation.

test_cases.title: Winner selection recorded, loser archived (RD-13)
test_cases.steps: 1. Verify developer selection entry in initiative report. 2. Verify losing track never merged.
test_cases.expected: Selection recorded; losing worktree/branch archived, not merged.

test_cases.title: DB projection + gates green at every stage close (RD-14)
test_cases.expected: Verify passes; all gates green; stage rows advance.

test_cases.title: Fleet pre-flight argv check for both track slots (PRD-FR-03)
test_cases.steps: 1. fleet-guard --check-argv for Track A kimi/GLM argv. 2. Same for Track B agy/gemini argv.

test_cases.title: Umbrella issue uses taxonomy labels only (PRD-FR-06)
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the umbrella issue labels. 2. Compare against .fleet/config.json labels taxonomy.
test_cases.expected: Every label exists in the taxonomy; issue links Discussion #335.
